clearedSpotChecks.check: L-842, task 1: every MegaETH PoolManager transaction that ends successfully with an ERC-20 still synced, and every later transaction of the same block that calls settle, settleFor or take.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The code model is right. sync stores the currency and the PoolManager balance in transient slots (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288, src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol:27-32), sync(0) and _settle reset the currency (src/PoolManager.sol:283, 362), and _settle credits msg.value when nothing is synced and the balance rise otherwise, refusing msg.value with an ERC-20 synced (src/PoolManager.sol:349-364). raw/analysis.json for 4326 shows 72,184 traced, empty traceFailures, settleMismatches and endsSyncedErc20, 54,803 settle checks, blocks 7,009,653 to 32,814,950; the census files hold 51,233 + 93 + 6,207 + 9,245 + 5,406 rows. web3_clientVersion at https://mainnet.megaeth.com/rpc returned mega-reth/v2.3.1-4499c42 in this session. The gap the item names (a sync-only transaction with no log and no Blockscout frame) does not matter, since every later settle in the set matched the model and a cross-transaction credit would appear there as a mismatch.
